functions.name: create_vaults
functions.description: Creates N vaults for multi-recipient disbursements, sharing one release ledger and one amount each.
constraints: all vaults share the same release_ledger
all vaults share the same amount
index entries written in the same transaction

constants.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
constants.description: Caps the number of recipients per batch to protect the resource budget.

notes: Entry-count trade-off: a batch of N recipients writes N vault entries + N index entries in one transaction, so the keeper needs a single due-check pass at the shared release_ledger instead of N separate passes.
MAX_BATCH_SIZE bounds the per-transaction footprint; batches over the cap must be split into multiple calls.
